title: Power Automate: Cloud flows - Share Process license capacity across workflows
description:
With flow groups, you can share Process license capacity across up to 25 cloud flows, optimizing license allocation and reducing costs for organizations operating higher-volume workflows that don't need their own dedicated capacity.

Prerequisites:

- Power Automate Process licenses available to the environment
- Cloud flows stored in solutions
- Power Automate maker permissions

Business Value:

Save costs, reduce management effort, and improve resource utilization by efficiently sharing capacity across multiple flows.

Enabled for:

Enabled for admins/makers/marketers automatically
